title: ArcCivs 0.1.15 to 0.1.16 physical storage and confirmed deletion
assumptions: Low/base/high are illustrative scenarios, not observations; participants 1/10/16 cities. Production, one-time reserve movement and deletion sensitivity are separate flows, not a repeat-grant loop.

Before physical mode silently combines native items with virtual reserves. After physical mode consumes only native containers; old reserves move through exact durable slot receipts, partial when full, preserving remainder. Virtual mode remains an explicit option with unchanged per-building 1728/3456/5184 item caps.

Before only central barrels plus at most16 explicitly registered containers count. After all chests/barrels inside building bounds join automatically, with central barrel first. Each physical half has27 real slots, so capacity is 27*N slots, 1728*N only for homogeneous64-stack items, less for unstackables/custom occupied slots. Existing manual compatibility containers keep16 cap. This increases reachable capacity, not production rate; filling containers no longer requires manual registration.

First-ever founder grant remains96 logs96 cobblestone24 bread once per owner across the network. Deletion/refounding still grants0/0/0 and creates0 free barrels. Legacy stock converts exactly remaining units; migration does not mint additional units.

Accepted construction continues charging exact schematic changes once; 12bread recruitment, levels and worker ceilings unchanged. Storage transitions preserve named/custom native items and no ground drops occur.

Worst continuous12L3-worker24h ceiling unchanged:138240logs or103680stone/raw crops or34560bread per city/day. More physical space can reduce full-storage downtime; actual utilization and sell-through are unmeasured. Shop SELL remains active, SELL-to-contract future; no invented new SELL price or exchange rate. Prior source assessment documents illustrative bread8Vault sensitivity, not fresh runtime price proof.

Direct Vault/tokens/XP changes are zero separately. Accepted delete can burn any remaining virtual/legacy units after warning, never physical items. No construction refund. No new currency price or progression fee, so no new savings-time calculation.

Decision: requested physical default and automatic container inclusion with indexed discovery, unchanged rates, explicit discard warning and receipt recovery. Verify slot idempotency/full storage/auto discovery/stocked deletion. Source and disk delivery do not imply live activation or native client acceptance.
